PgoType.evidence_source: Participants also completed Button et al.'s (1996) measure of goal orientation. This measure includes eight items that assess learning orientation and eight items that assess performance orientation.

AdaptMeasures.evidence_source: Role structure adaptation... coding the activity of each team on a trial-by-trial basis with respect to whether Charlie received a text message with the RCA value from Alpha. Teams were assigned a score for each of the 20 postchange decision trials, indicating whether the team used an effective adapted role structure for that trial (1 = effectively adapted and 0 = failed to effectively adapt). As a check on the validity of this coding scheme, I obtained ratings from two doctoral-level students of team adaptation using the 8-item scale developed by LePine (2003).

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the variables used in the study, including the manipulation and measurement of goal difficulty, the assessment of cognitive ability using the Wonderlic Personnel Test, and goal orientation using Button et al.'s (1996) measure (including performance orientation). It also thoroughly describes the measurement of role structure adaptation through objective coding of team activity, which was validated by ratings from doctoral students. The section mentions a pilot study used for setting goal levels and a primary study for which these variables were measured.
